intent_en: To illustrate the increasing trend of very unfavorable attitudes between Democrats and Republicans towards each other from 1994 to 2016.
previous_intent: To demonstrate the significant increase in very unfavorable attitudes between the Democratic and Republican parties over time, highlighting the growing trend of political polarization.
narration_support: The Democrats have followed a similar trajectory over the years.
chart_support: Bar chart displaying 'Very Unfavorable Attitude Towards The Other Side' for Democrats and Republicans across years 1994, 2008, 2014, and 2016, showing a consistent upward trend for both groups.
evidence_note: Narration focuses on 2008-2016 data and mentions a 'similar trajectory', while the chart provides the full timeline including 1994 baseline showing lower initial unfavorable attitudes.
